dialog.title: Connect your wallet
dialog.connectedDescription: You are signed in with your wallet.

errors.notInstalled: {{walletName}} was not found. Install the extension or open this site in the wallet browser, then try again.
errors.unsupported: {{walletName}} does not support Solana wallet sign-in. Update your wallet and try again.
errors.invalidWalletResponse: {{walletName}} returned an invalid sign-in response. Please try again.
errors.rejected: The signature request was declined. You can try again when you are ready.
errors.requestPending: A wallet request is already open. Complete it in your wallet, then try again.
errors.challengeInvalid: The sign-in request expired or was already used. Please try again with a new request.
errors.signatureInvalid: Your wallet signature could not be verified. Please try again.
errors.originNotAllowed: Sign-in is not available from this site address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment before trying again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Could not check your session. Please try connecting again.
errors.failed: Could not complete the wallet request. Please try again.
